name: Healing Area
description: A small chamber associated with the shaman. Bandages, herbs, splints, needles, thread, potions, and crude surgical tools are stored here. Treatment is pragmatic: keep the injured goblin alive long enough to heal.

items.name: Healing Herbs
items.description: A bundle of herbs used for basic treatment.

items.name: Healing Potion
items.description: A small vial of red liquid. It smells medicinal.
